title: 2018 AMC 12B Problem 18
statement: A function \(f\) is defined recursively by \(f(1)=f(2)=1\) and \[ f(n)=f(n-1)-f(n-2)+n \] for all integers \(n\ge3.\) What is \(f(2018)?\)

solutions.text:
Repeatedly substituting the recursion into itself gives \[ f(n)=f(n-6)+6. \] So \(f\) increases by \(6\) every time \(n\) increases by \(6.\)

Since \(2018=2+6\cdot336,\) we have \(f(2018)=f(2)+6\cdot336\) \(=1+2016=2017.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Compute several terms and look for a pattern in \(f(n)-n\)
Expanding the recursion four times shows \(f(n)=f(n-6)+6\)
